features.title: Fast menus
features.description: Shortens the menu's scripted animations and shows images as soon as they are loaded, without the fade.

options.title: Animation speed
options.description: How much faster the menu animations run: 2 makes them twice as short, 1 keeps the sim's speed. Looping animations (loading indicators) keep their pace.

options.title: Images without fade
options.description: Shows images at once instead of fading them in.

features.title: Weather and time bar
features.description: A bar on Free Flight with one-click weather presets and times of day (dawn, day, dusk, night, computed from the sun at the departure airport).

options.title: Remember the last choice
options.description: Applies the last weather, time of day, traffic and multiplayer choice again when the sim starts.

options.title: METAR section
options.description: Shows the real weather (METAR) at the departure airport with its flight category, and the simulated weather when Live is off.

options.title: Traffic section
options.description: Shows buttons for air traffic and multiplayer.

features.title: Mouse wheel on the time
features.description: The mouse wheel over the Flight Conditions widget moves the time: later upwards, earlier downwards. With live weather it moves within the last 24 hours.

options.title: Step
options.description: Time shift for one notch of the wheel.

options.title: Step with Shift
options.description: Time shift for one notch of the wheel while Shift is held.

features.title: Tail number per livery
features.description: Each livery keeps its own tail number: the one you type is applied again whenever that livery is selected.

features.title: Aircraft setup panel
features.description: A panel in the aircraft selection under the aircraft's title on three lines (model, brand, studio) with the variants, the tail number and the Fuel and Identification buttons; in the Showcase view also the liveries (the current one large, the others in a grid of three per row) with their favourites, and the sim's Configure tile beside the tail number and the two buttons. Without the Aircraft gallery and list feature, the panel always takes its Showcase form.

options.title: Widen the left column
options.description: Extra width of the left column, in layout units (the screen is 1080 units high; the sim's column is 470 wide). 0 keeps the sim's width. In Showcase it has no effect above 90 units, and the column is never narrower than the width where the labels of the panel's bottom block show whole; in Gallery and List the column is 400 units wide instead.

features.title: Aircraft gallery and list
features.description: Replaces the aircraft list with a gallery or a compact list beside the liveries of the current aircraft, or with large tiles scrolling sideways (Showcase), with favourite liveries, a filter and sorts by model, manufacturer and studio.

options.title: Remember my layout
options.description: Brings the last view, sort and sort direction back when the sim starts. Off, every start of the sim opens Showcase sorted by Model, A to Z.

options.title: Remember my last plane
options.description: The mod keeps your last aircraft, variant and livery, and brings them back the first time Free Flight shows after the sim starts (the sim does not keep them). Off, the first time Free Flight shows after the sim starts, the first aircraft of the All tab (sorted by Model, A to Z, hidden aircraft left out) is selected with its first livery.

features.title: Favourites on Free Flight
features.description: A Favorites block on Free Flight to load a favourite livery directly, with its aircraft and variant.
